name: Open Graph
description: Checks for Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image required; og:url, og:type recommended) and that og:url agrees with the canonical URL. OG tags give social platforms and LLM crawlers a clean, structured summary of the page.

scoring.summary: Tags are read only via meta[property="og:X"]. Start at 3: -0.75 per missing required tag (og:title, og:description, og:image), -0.75 per present-but-empty required tag, -0.25 if og:url missing, -0.25 if og:type missing, -0.25 if og:url and a canonical both exist and normalizeUrl(og:url) !== normalizeUrl(canonical href). An og:image that is not an absolute URL adds an issue but no deduction. finalScore = max(0, round(score*10)/10); status from finalScore; reported score = floor(finalScore).

rules.condition: getMetaContent(p) = document.querySelector('meta[property="'+p+'"]')?.content, null if element absent (meta name="og:*" is NOT read)
each of og:title, og:description, og:image missing (null)
each of og:title, og:description, og:image present but content.trim() empty
og:image truthy but new URL(og:image) throws (relative URL such as '/img.png')

og:url truthy AND link[rel="canonical"] exists AND normalizeUrl(og:url) !== normalizeUrl(canonical.href). normalizeUrl = protocol//hostname + pathname + search, trailing '/' removed, lowercased (port and hash dropped). canonical.href is resolved to absolute by the browser.

scoring.status_mapping: Using decimal finalScore: >= 2.5 pass, >= 1.5 warning, else fail. Examples: all present and consistent => 3 pass; missing og:url or og:type or mismatch => 2.75 pass/2; missing url+type => 2.5 pass/2; one required missing => 2.25 warning/2; nothing at all => 0.25 fail/0.

detect.source_procedure: Per page, collect og:* meta tags and the canonical link. Static HTML / Vite: *.html, index.html. Astro: layouts/SEO components (astro-seo openGraph prop, custom Head.astro). Hugo: layouts/partials/head*.html, {{ template "_internal/opengraph.html" . }} (emits og:title, og:description, og:type, og:url, og:image when images/params set) and canonical from .Permalink; baseURL from hugo.toml. Eleventy: _includes/** layouts. Next.js app router: metadata.openGraph {title, description, images, url, type} and metadata.alternates.canonical plus metadataBase in app/**/layout.tsx|page.tsx; pages router: <Head> or next-seo. Resolve template values to strings (use site base URL from config to absolutize canonical), then apply rules.

parity.note: Exact for literal tags. Differs for runtime-injected tags, framework or plugin defaults not visible in source (Hugo internal templates, Next.js metadata merging and metadataBase absolutization), template values empty at build time, and og:url vs canonical comparison when either depends on deployment base URL or trailing-slash settings of the host.

fix_summary: Add og:title, og:description, og:image (absolute URL), og:url (equal to the canonical) and og:type (website or article) as <meta property=...> in the shared head layout, or via Next.js metadata.openGraph, Hugo _internal/opengraph.html with images params, Astro/Eleventy layout head.
